title: Production AI Going Live
intent: Problem: an AI system is about to launch and approval evidence must survive launch
brief: Launch approval is a point-in-time proof. The page defines what must be baselined before go-live so assurance can be held after it: evaluation set, thresholds, telemetry, cost envelope, rollback.

title: RAG Quality Degradation
intent: Problem: answers from a retrieval-augmented system are getting worse without an obvious failure
brief: Users report worse answers; nothing is down. Walks through isolating retrieval from generation, corpus staleness, index and embedding change, and what verified restoration looks like.

title: AI Agent With Write Access
intent: Problem: an agent is being granted the ability to change systems of record
brief: Moving an agent from read to write changes the consequence of every error and every injection. Covers scoped credentials, approval thresholds, reversible actions, action audit and blast-radius limits.

title: Model Provider Migration
intent: Problem: moving a production workload to a different model or provider, by choice or by retirement
brief: A model swap invalidates prior evaluation evidence. Covers behavioural equivalence testing, prompt and tool-schema portability, safety boundary re-test, cost and latency envelope, staged cutover and reversal.

title: AI Cost Spike
intent: Problem: AI spend has risen sharply and the cause is not yet attributed
brief: Spend rose faster than usage. Covers attribution to feature and tenant, agent loops, context growth, cache miss, retry storms, model tier change, and what proves the correction held.

title: AI Audit Readiness
intent: Problem: an audit, regulator or customer will ask for evidence about an AI system
brief: Evidence reconstructed for an audit is weaker than evidence retained as the system ran. Covers the evidence set examiners ask for, retention, attribution to system version, and gaps typically found.

title: Cloud Incident Recurrence
intent: Problem: the same class of production incident keeps returning
brief: Repeat incidents indicate corrective actions that were recorded but not completed or not verified. Covers action completion evidence, recurrence testing, shared contributing factors and recurrence-rate thresholds.

title: Untested Disaster Recovery
intent: Problem: a recovery plan exists but has not been exercised under realistic conditions
brief: A documented plan with no timed exercise is unassured, not acceptable. Covers scoping a first exercise, measuring actual recovery time and point, restore verification, and converting findings into owned corrections.

title: Kubernetes Upgrade Risk
intent: Problem: clusters are approaching end of support or an upgrade is overdue
brief: Deferred upgrades compound: more versions to cross, more removed APIs, paid extended support or forced upgrades. Covers support position, API removal exposure, add-on compatibility, rehearsal evidence and verified completion.
